summary: A Yes vote requires two-thirds voter approval before parks, parkland, or open space in the City of Cupertino may be rezoned or developed.

housing.text: A Yes vote requires voter approval by two-thirds support for rezoning or developing Cupertino parks, parkland, or open space for residential, commercial, or industrial uses.
housing.quote: Shall an ordinance amending the City of Cupertino General Plan be adopted to mandate that any attempt to rezone parks, parklands or open space to residential, commercial or industrial uses, or any proposal for residential, commercial or industrial development in parks, parkland or open space, must be placed before Cupertino voters and secure two-thirds support in the City's next general election?

housing.text: A No vote does not impose this voter-approval requirement for those rezoning or development proposals.
